title: Gnosis Tantra
author: The Eremite
description: In this Podcast we delve into the profound spiritual teachings of V.M. Samael Aun Weor, a renowned figure in the world of Gnosticism. Known for his doctrine of "Universal Gnosticism," Aun Weor's teachings emphasize the practical and esoteric principles aimed at awakening and fundamentally transforming the psychological condition of individuals. Join us as we explore his spiritual ideals and bases, including the concepts of "Christification" and "Final Liberation."
